Requirements:
1. New independent correction endpoint (POST /records/corrections or similar). Correction binds subjectKey, purpose, epoch, recordKey, expectedRecordVersion (initial 1). Each successful correction appends a full new payload, version +1, max 1000 chars payload. Old versions retained.

3. Original write same-key-different-content 409 rule unchanged.
4. Old versions can't be the base for next correction: version mismatch → 409, doesn't consume request key. New payload identical to current → no version increment, return current snapshot.
5. After revoke: new corrections, history reads, and replays of old payload-bearing requests → 410. New epoch after re-grant starts record versions from 1 independently, not mixed with old chain.

public RecordVersionResponse correct(CorrectRecordRequest request) {
    // 授权状态先于载荷重放：先确认代次存在且当前有效
    ConsentRepository.GrantRow grant = consentRepository
            .findGrantForUpdate(request.subjectKey(), request.purpose(), request.epoch())
            .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.notFound(CODE_GRANT_NOT_FOUND, "授权代次不存在"));
    requireGrantActive(grant.subjectKey(), grant.purpose(), grant.epoch());

    String fingerprint = structuredFingerprint(OP_CORRECT, ...);
    Optional<IdempotencyRow> replayed = checkReplay(request.requestId(), fingerprint);
    if (replayed.isPresent()) {
        return readSnapshot(replayed.get().responseBody(), RecordVersionResponse.class);
    }

    consentRepository.findRecord(...).orElseThrow(RECORD_NOT_FOUND);
    ConsentRepository.VersionRow latest = consentRepository.findLatestRecordVersion(...)
            .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.notFound(CODE_RECORD_NOT_FOUND, "记录不存在"));
    if (latest.recordVersion() != request.expectedRecordVersion()) {
        throw ApiException.conflict(CODE_RECORD_VERSION_CONFLICT, "记录版本与期望不一致");
    }
    RecordVersionResponse response;
    if (latest.payload().equals(request.payload())) {
        response = toVersionResponse(latest);
    } else {
        int nextVersion = latest.recordVersion() + 1;
        try {
            consentRepository.insertRecordVersion(..., nextVersion, request.payload(), request.requestId());
            consentRepository.updateRecordPayload(..., request.payload());
        } catch (DuplicateKeyException concurrent) {
            ConsentRepository.VersionRow committed = findLatestRecordVersion...;
            if (committed.recordVersion() != nextVersion || !committed.payload().equals(request.payload())) {

            }
            response = toVersionResponse(committed);
            storeSuccess(...); return response;
        }
        response = new RecordVersionResponse(..., nextVersion, request.payload());
    }
    storeSuccess(request.requestId(), OP_CORRECT, fingerprint, response);
    return response;
}
